notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are 'other governmental funds'), no enterprise funds so business_type is null. Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p3-4). Roll-forward on the printed total: 36,205,512 + 16,667,830 - 33,481,751 = 19,391,591; the p4 disbursement lines add to 33,481,684 (67 short, see report_discrepancies), so the line-based identity is off by 67. The 'Issuance of bonds' line on p4 is (80,000) General / 80,000 Other funds and nets to zero in the total column (it is really the General-to-Activities interfund transfer, see p9 and p16); transfers_in/out left null. Attempt 3 (re-check 2026-10-28): statement 'State receipts' 6,292,944 split with split_from using the fund schedules (General p6, School Nutrition p11, Bond p12, Special Building p14, which add exactly to each fund column): Homestead Exemption 189,555, Property Tax Credit 2,936,669, Nameplate Capacity Tax 195,469, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 18,655, remaining state aid 2,952,596; 'Other receipts' tuition 28,585 split out as Tuition Received and the 2210 ESU 650 part as ESU Receipts; balance sheet now from the governmental funds Statement of Assets and Fund Balances (p5, Total Governmental Funds, fund balance by classification), whose totals equal the government-wide statement (p2, 19,391,591); 3535/3540/3541 General Fund spending lines (printed with no heading and counted in the statement Instruction line) moved from State Categorical Programs to Instruction. Attempt 4 (2026-10-28): the Other receipts split's rentals (1910 21,071 + 1942 7 = 21,078) are now a separate Rentals item (charges for services keeps 1740 Fees 15,485); detail 1910 Rentals -> Rentals; School Nutrition Fund Sales -> School Lunch Sales (matching the statement line). 1740 Fees kept as charges for services (the schedule doesn't say they are student activity fees). Student support services (1,503,466) split by its fund columns: General 950,832 support services, Other Governmental 552,634 (Activities Fund 'other support services', p16) student activities. Operation and maintenance of plant 1,450,949 includes Depreciation Fund capital outlay 68,869. Detail: General Fund budget schedule p6-9 (General Fund schedule beginning balance 5,022,254 excludes Depreciation Fund 121,466; sum = statement 5,143,720). General Fund expenditure lines are function-level, so detail_category is not itemized; 2220/2230 are printed under the 2100 heading (no 2200 heading) and make up the statement's Instructional support line. General Fund schedule disbursement lines sum to 12,526,082; 400,000 of that is the interfund transfer to the Depreciation Fund (p10) that the statements eliminate (p4 GF 12,217,212 = 12,526,082 - 400,000 + Depreciation 91,130); the line is not identified (the p4 statement shows it coming out of the instruction-related group as a whole), so one contra line (-400,000, p4 elimination; function shown as Federal Programs is a placeholder for that group) plus an other financing line were added, both flagged review; the general fund 'includes other financing' total 12,606,082 = expenditure lines net 12,126,082 + transfers 480,000. Lines with blank 2025 actual (budget-only) were skipped (e.g. 2213 Staff training, Bond fund carline, Special Building bond proceeds, Bond Fund refund on bond). Bond fund and Special Building cash detail (certificates of deposit, US Treasury securities) not recorded separately. Activities Fund has one line so no per-account schedule; no printed revenue total, so no detail_totals entry. Statement line Other receipts 130,519 split by category using the General Fund schedule lines (p6-7, which sum exactly to the General Fund column 129,969) plus Special Building 550 (kept as other). Read pages 1-16 of 16
